summary: Iteration 46 — Verified bug fix (face profile orphan purge on siswa delete) + new features: Piket monthly report + Face enroll 'Mode Per Kelas'. 10/10 backend pytest pass. UI smoke on /face-enroll and /piket Laporan Bulanan confirms all requested data-testids and flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 5597 lines — still exceeds recommended 700-line cap; please split into feature modules (piket, face, users, etc.) in a future refactor.

_face_purge_orphans runs on every face_students / face_matrix call. For large schools consider doing it lazily or on user-delete only (already present) + a nightly cron, to avoid O(users) distinct() scans on hot paths.
/api/piket/shifts allows creating a shift with a past date (useful for backfill, but no explicit guard). Confirm this is intentional UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (face-enroll batch mode toast + progress + stop, piket laporan tab + month nav + export button all working)

test_credentials: Super admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Test guru/siswa accounts created with @example.com and deleted in teardown.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ users (siswa A/B/C, TEST_Guru_Report), piket_shifts (gate TEST_Gerbang_Report), face_profiles, attendance for test users were cleaned up in teardown. The real student Frederic Sibarani was NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter46_face_rebind_piket_report.py is the regression suite. Covers: (1) face profile removal on user DELETE, (2) re-enrol same face after delete succeeds, (3) face-scan returns correct student, (4) orphan face profile injected directly in Mongo is purged on next enroll, (5) face/students enrolled<=total invariant, (6) piket report counts (hadir/tidak_hadir), invalid-month 400, guru 403, xlsx export. Note: pytest.ini applies xdist by default — must run with `-o addopts=""` so class-level state carries between tests.
rca of the issue: User's original bug 'Wajah ini sangat mirip dengan siswa lain yang sudah terdaftar' after deleting a siswa was fixed by: (a) delete_user() cascades to db.face_profiles.delete_many({student_id: uid}) and forces _face_matrix(force=True) refresh, (b) _face_purge_orphans() is called inside _face_matrix and inside face_students & face_enroll flows so any stale profile pointing to a non-existent/non-siswa user is deleted before duplicate-face check runs. Verified by test_04 which seeds an orphan directly in Mongo and confirms it is purged after a subsequent enroll.
